author: Jessica Frattare
body: I bought a sleep plan for my 7 month old who had such a hard time sleeping, and doing it independently. Andrea recommended the course for my baby’s age and when purchasing, it asked a bunch of questions so it could be tailored to my child, as well as my schedule, our nursing schedule, and my expectations. When I got the plan, I was blown away with all the options in mind that were tailored to my family. After 3 nights, my baby was sleeping 8 hours straight and falling asleep within 15 minutes. It’s been 2 weeks and she now sleeps about 11-12 hours each night and 1-2 hours for both of her naps, in her crib independently. We are SO thankful for this sleep plan. THANK YOU, ANDREA!
